factor_diagnostics.value_notes: Hawaii archival-tag data published before the 2018 taxonomic revision for the legacy opah complex show fish in roughly 8-20 °C water by day and 16-22 °C at night, with peak nighttime frequency at 18-20 °C. These are ambient temperatures associated with diel vertical behavior, not a fixed surface-temperature preference. The historical tagging cannot be confidently assigned specifically to Lampris incognitus; treat it as legacy Pacific-opah-complex context only. It does not validate the configured 14-22 °C / 16-20 °C SST suitability curve.

This supports bathymetry as a possible regional distribution proxy, not the configured 50-400 m seafloor-depth response interval.
